assessment_area: California, North and Central model components
selection_basis: Selected one California stock unit represented by northern and central model components. NOAA Stock SMART records 17194 and 17195 are grouped under the California unit; their area labels do not map one-to-one to the Point Arena model split. The 2023 native model archive is available. Preserve each component's inputs and outputs without pooling source observations or biology. NOAA's peer-review record identifies the final assessment work product as disseminated by April 2024; the detailed report retains provisional front matter, so retain this publication caveat.
